fields.install-cmd: set -e; . /etc/os-release; if [ -n "${UBUNTU_CODENAME:-}" ]; then case "$UBUNTU_CODENAME" in focal) SEG=ubuntu2004;; jammy) SEG=ubuntu2204;; noble) SEG=ubuntu2404;; *) SEG=ubuntu2204;; esac; elif [ "$ID" = debian ]; then SEG="debian${VERSION_ID%%.*}"; else SEG="${ID}$(echo "$VERSION_ID" | tr -d .)"; fi; A="$(uname -m)"; if [ "$A" = aarch64 ]; then A=sbsa; else A=x86_64; fi; T="$(mktemp -d)"; curl -fSL "https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/cuda/repos/$SEG/$A/cuda-keyring_1.1-1_all.deb" -o "$T/k.deb"; sudo dpkg -i "$T/k.deb"; sudo apt-get update; rm -rf "$T"
